dishes.name: Moong Dal Chilla with Pudina Chutney
dishes.desc: High in protein and light on oil.
steps: Soak moong dal for 3 hours and grind with green chilli.
Spread a thin chilla on a tawa and brush with a little oil.
Cook both sides and serve with pudina-dahi chutney.

dishes.name: Lauki Chana Dal with Phulka
dishes.desc: A light sabzi that is easy to digest.
steps: Soak chana dal for 30 minutes.
Pressure cook jeera, tamatar, lauki and dal with haldi and salt.
Serve the hot sabzi with freshly made phulkas.

dishes.name: Palak Paneer with Roti
dishes.desc: The classic pairing of spinach and paneer.
steps: Blanch the palak and blend to a puree.
Saute pyaaz and tamatar, then add the palak puree and spices.
Add paneer cubes, cook for 3 minutes and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Poha with Moongfali
dishes.desc: A light breakfast that is ready fast.
steps: Rinse the poha and drain well.
Temper rai, moongfali, pyaaz and green chilli in oil.
Add poha, haldi and salt, cover for 2 minutes and finish with nimbu.

dishes.name: Rajma Chawal with Kachumber
dishes.desc: Everyone's favourite comfort food.
steps: Soak rajma overnight and boil in a pressure cooker.
Make a pyaaz-tamatar masala, add the rajma and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve hot over chawal with kachumber on the side.

dishes.name: Bhindi Masala with Dal Tadka and Roti
dishes.desc: Crisp bhindi with very little oil.
steps: Wash bhindi, dry it completely and chop.
Cook bhindi with pyaaz, covered, and add the spices.
Boil the dal and finish with a lahsun-jeera tadka. Serve with roti.

dishes.name: Vegetable Upma
dishes.desc: A light breakfast of sooji and vegetables.
steps: Dry roast the sooji and set aside.
Temper rai, pyaaz, vegetables and curry patta in oil.
Add water, bring to a boil, stir in the sooji and cover for 3 minutes.

dishes.name: Kadhi Chawal
dishes.desc: Tangy and mildly sweet dahi kadhi.
steps: Whisk dahi, besan and water until smooth.
Cook on low heat, stirring, for about 15 minutes after it comes to a boil.
Finish with a jeera and curry patta tadka and serve with chawal.

dishes.name: Masala Anda Bhurji with Multigrain Roti
dishes.desc: A quick, protein-rich dinner.
steps: Saute pyaaz, tamatar and green chilli in oil.
Crack in the eggs, add the spices and scramble.
Serve hot with multigrain roti.

dishes.name: Aloo Paratha with Dahi
dishes.desc: A hot paratha with very little ghee.
steps: Mash boiled aloo with salt, green chilli and dhaniya.
Stuff the filling into atta dough and roll out.
Cook on a tawa with a little ghee on both sides and serve with dahi.

dishes.name: Masoor Dal with Tinda Sabzi and Phulka
dishes.desc: A light, homely thali.
steps: Pressure cook masoor dal with haldi and salt for 3 whistles.
Cook tinda covered with jeera and tamatar.
Temper the dal and serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Masala Khichdi with Dahi and Achaar
dishes.desc: A light, balanced dinner.
steps: Wash the chawal and moong dal.
Make a ghee-jeera tadka and pressure cook with haldi and salt.
Serve hot khichdi with dahi and achaar.

dishes.name: Paneer Sandwich (Brown Bread)
dishes.desc: Grilled, with very little butter.
steps: Crumble the paneer and mix with chopped vegetables, salt and black pepper.
Spread chutney on the bread and add the filling.
Toast on a tawa or in a toaster until golden.

dishes.name: Arhar Dal with Aloo Gobhi and Roti
dishes.desc: Everyday sabzi and dal.
steps: Pressure cook the dal and add a tadka.
Cook aloo and gobhi covered with adrak, haldi and dhaniya.
Serve with hot roti.

dishes.name: Mix Veg Pulao with Raita
dishes.desc: A complete meal in one pot.
steps: Wash chawal and soak for 20 minutes.
Saute jeera, tej patta and the vegetables, then add the chawal.
Add double the water and cover. Serve with dahi raita.

dishes.name: Sooji Cheela with Vegetables
dishes.desc: A quick, crisp breakfast.
steps: Mix sooji and dahi into a batter and rest for 15 minutes.
Stir in chopped vegetables and spread thinly on a tawa.
Cook both sides and serve with chutney.

dishes.name: Kala Chana Curry with Phulka
dishes.desc: Rich in fibre and protein.
steps: Soak kala chana overnight and boil in a pressure cooker.
Make a pyaaz-tamatar masala and add the chana.
Simmer for 10 minutes and serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Baingan Bharta with Roti
dishes.desc: Smoky roasted baingan.
steps: Roast the baingan over a flame, peel and mash.
Saute lahsun, pyaaz and tamatar.
Add the baingan, cook for 5 minutes and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Methi Thepla with Dahi
dishes.desc: A breakfast with fresh methi.
steps: Knead a soft dough with chopped methi, atta, besan and spices.
Roll thin and cook on a tawa.
Serve with dahi.

dishes.name: Chhole Bhature (Baked Bhature)
dishes.desc: A Sunday special, with less oil.
steps: Soak chane overnight and boil with tea leaves.
Make a pyaaz-tamatar masala, add the chane and chole masala and simmer for 15 minutes.
Knead maida and dahi into a dough, roll out the bhature and bake or cook on a tawa.

dishes.name: Palak Dal with Jeera Rice
dishes.desc: A light dinner after a heavy lunch.
steps: Pressure cook the dal with chopped palak.
Add a lahsun-jeera tadka.
Serve with jeera chawal.

dishes.name: Masala Omelette with Toast
dishes.desc: A fluffy omelette with vegetables.
steps: Whisk eggs with chopped pyaaz, green chilli, dhaniya and salt.
Cook the omelette on a tawa in a little oil.
Serve hot with toast.

dishes.name: Soya Chunk Pulao with Raita
dishes.desc: A protein-rich pulao.
steps: Soak soya chunks in hot water and squeeze out the water.
Saute spices, pyaaz, matar and the soya in oil.
Add chawal and water and cook. Serve with raita.

dishes.name: Mixed Dal with Gobhi Sabzi and Roti
dishes.desc: A balance of dals and vegetables.
steps: Pressure cook the mixed dal and add a tadka.
Cook gobhi covered with adrak and jeera.
Serve with roti.

dishes.name: Namkeen Dalia with Vegetables
dishes.desc: Full of fibre and good for the heart.
steps: Saute jeera, pyaaz and vegetables in oil.
Add the dalia and roast for 2 minutes.
Add 3 times the water and cook until soft.

dishes.name: Dal Makhani (Light) with Roti
dishes.desc: A creamy dal with less butter.
steps: Soak urad and rajma overnight and pressure cook until very soft.
Add tamatar puree and spices and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes.
Finish with a little makhan and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Aloo Methi with Roti and Dahi
dishes.desc: A winter favourite with mild spices.
steps: Saute chopped aloo with lahsun and jeera.
Add methi, cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve with roti and dahi.

dishes.name: Gobhi Paratha with Dahi
dishes.desc: A hot, spiced paratha.
steps: Grate the gobhi, squeeze out the water and mix in spices.
Stuff into atta dough and roll out.
Cook on a tawa and serve with dahi.

dishes.name: Tamatar Dhaniya Dal with Jeera Aloo and Roti
dishes.desc: A fresh, fragrant dal.
steps: Cook the dal with tamatar and stir in dhaniya.
Saute aloo with jeera until tender.
Serve with roti.

dishes.name: Egg Curry with Roti
dishes.desc: A homestyle spiced egg curry.
steps: Boil the eggs, peel and make a slit in each.
Make a pyaaz-tamatar masala and add water.
Add the eggs, simmer for 5 minutes and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Besan Cheela with Green Chutney
dishes.desc: Warm, soft and high in protein.
steps: Mix besan with water, salt and ajwain into a batter.
Add chopped vegetables and cook thin cheelas on a tawa.
Serve hot with green chutney.

dishes.name: Lobia Curry with Rice
dishes.desc: A light, dal-like curry.
steps: Soak lobia for 4 hours and boil in a pressure cooker.
Make a pyaaz, tamatar and adrak masala.
Add the lobia and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with chawal.

dishes.name: Moong Dal Khichdi with Lauki Raita
dishes.desc: Light and gentle on the stomach.
steps: Pressure cook chawal and dhuli moong dal with a ghee-jeera tadka.
Boil grated lauki and mix into dahi to make the raita.
Serve the hot khichdi with the raita.

dishes.name: Masala Oats with Vegetables
dishes.desc: Ready in minutes.
steps: Saute jeera, pyaaz and vegetables in oil.
Add water and spices and bring to a boil.
Stir in the oats and cook for 3 minutes.

dishes.name: Dahi Wale Aloo with Moong Dal and Roti
dishes.desc: Tangy dahi aloo.
steps: Boil the aloo, cut into pieces and saute with jeera.
Add whisked dahi and spices and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve with moong dal tadka and roti.

dishes.name: Matar Paneer with Roti
dishes.desc: Made with fresh winter matar.
steps: Make a pyaaz-tamatar masala and blend it.
Add the matar and cook for 8 minutes.
Add paneer, cover for 3 minutes and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Paneer Paratha with Chaas
dishes.desc: A filling, protein-rich breakfast.
steps: Crumble the paneer and mix in the spices.
Stuff into atta dough and roll out.
Cook with a little ghee and serve with chaas.

dishes.name: Kaddu Sabzi with Chana Dal and Phulka
dishes.desc: A lightly sweet kaddu sabzi.
steps: Pressure cook the chana dal and add a tadka.
Cook kaddu covered with methi dana and amchur.
Serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Mushroom Matar with Phulka
dishes.desc: A light and tasty sabzi.
steps: Make a pyaaz-tamatar masala.
Add the mushroom and matar and cook for 8 minutes.
Serve hot with phulka.

dishes.name: Missi Roti with Dahi and Achaar
dishes.desc: A fragrant roti of besan and atta.
steps: Knead besan, atta, ajwain, salt and green chilli into a dough.
Roll out and cook on a tawa.
Serve with dahi and achaar.

dishes.name: Veg Biryani with Boondi Raita
dishes.desc: A fragrant biryani full of vegetables.
steps: Soak basmati chawal for 20 minutes and parboil.
Cook the vegetables in dahi and biryani masala.
Layer, cover and cook on dum for 15 minutes. Serve with boondi raita.

dishes.name: Tamatar Soup with Veg Sandwich
dishes.desc: A light dinner.
steps: Boil the tamatar, blend, season with salt and black pepper and strain.
Layer vegetables between slices of bread to make sandwiches.
Serve hot soup with toasted sandwiches.

dishes.name: Mooli Paratha with Dahi
dishes.desc: A classic winter paratha.
steps: Grate the mooli, squeeze out all the water and mix in spices.
Stuff into atta dough and roll out.
Cook on a tawa with a little ghee and serve with dahi.

dishes.name: Arbi Masala with Moong Dal Tadka and Roti
dishes.desc: Pan-cooked arbi with little oil.
steps: Boil arbi, peel and cut.
Cook on a tawa with ajwain, spices and amchur.
Serve with moong dal tadka and roti.

dishes.name: Bharwan Shimla Mirch with Roti
dishes.desc: Shimla mirch stuffed with spices.
steps: Mash aloo and mix with besan and spices for the filling.
Stuff the filling into the shimla mirch.
Cook covered on low heat and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Moong Sprouts Chaat Bowl
dishes.desc: Fresh and rich in protein.
steps: Lightly steam the sprouts.
Mix with chopped vegetables, salt and chaat masala.
Squeeze nimbu on top and serve warm or cold.

dishes.name: Gajar Matar Sabzi with Dal Tadka and Phulka
dishes.desc: A colourful winter sabzi.
steps: Cook gajar and matar covered with jeera.
Boil the dal and add a tadka.
Serve hot with phulka.

dishes.name: Paneer Bhurji with Roti
dishes.desc: A quick, spiced bhurji.
steps: Saute pyaaz, tamatar and green chilli in oil.
Add crumbled paneer and spices and cook for 4 minutes.
Serve hot with roti.

dishes.name: Palak Paratha with Dahi
dishes.desc: A green, healthy paratha.
steps: Finely chop palak and knead into atta with salt and ajwain.
Roll out and cook on a tawa.
Serve with dahi.

dishes.name: Matar Pulao with Raita
dishes.desc: A fragrant pulao with fresh matar.
steps: Wash chawal and soak for 20 minutes.
Saute jeera, tej patta and matar in ghee, then add the chawal.
Add double the water and cook. Serve with raita.

dishes.name: Lauki Kofta Curry with Roti
dishes.desc: Koftas cooked with very little oil.
steps: Grate lauki, squeeze out the water and mix with besan and spices to form koftas.
Cook the koftas in an appe pan or oven.
Add to a tamatar-pyaaz gravy and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Suji Uttapam with Veggies
dishes.desc: A soft uttapam with a light chutney.
steps: Mix sooji and dahi into a batter and rest for 15 minutes.
Spread a thick layer on a tawa and top with vegetables.
Cook both sides and serve with chutney.

dishes.name: Baingan Aloo with Chana Dal and Roti
dishes.desc: A homestyle dry sabzi.
steps: Pressure cook the chana dal and add a tadka.
Cook baingan and aloo covered with jeera and haldi.
Serve with roti.

dishes.name: Vegetable Dalia Khichdi with Dahi
dishes.desc: A fibre-rich, light khichdi.
steps: Roast the dalia and dal with ghee and jeera.
Add vegetables and 4 times the water and pressure cook.
Serve hot with dahi.

dishes.name: Anda Bhurji Toast
dishes.desc: Spiced scrambled egg on crisp toast.
steps: Saute pyaaz, tamatar and green chilli in oil.
Crack in the eggs and scramble.
Serve on toast while hot.

dishes.name: Dal Fry with Jeera Aloo and Roti
dishes.desc: Dhaba style, with less oil.
steps: Pressure cook the dal.
Make a pyaaz-tamatar tadka and pour it over the dal.
Serve with jeera aloo and roti.

dishes.name: Shimla Mirch Paneer with Roti
dishes.desc: A quick dry sabzi.
steps: Saute pyaaz and shimla mirch on high heat.
Add tamatar and spices, then the paneer.
Cover for 3 minutes and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Aloo Tikki with Chutney
dishes.desc: Crisp tikkis cooked on a tawa.
steps: Mash boiled aloo and mix with bread crumbs and spices.
Shape into tikkis and cook on a tawa with a little oil.
Serve with imli and green chutney.

dishes.name: Methi Matar Malai (Light) with Roti
dishes.desc: A light, creamy methi and matar sabzi.
steps: Saute pyaaz, then add tamatar and spices.
Add methi and matar and cook for 8 minutes.
Turn off the heat, stir in whisked dahi and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Soya Keema Matar with Phulka
dishes.desc: A vegetarian keema, rich in protein.
steps: Soak soya granules in hot water and squeeze out the water.
Make a pyaaz-tamatar masala and add the soya and matar.
Cook for 10 minutes and serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Vegetable Sevai Upma
dishes.desc: A light breakfast that is ready fast.
steps: Lightly roast the sevai and boil in hot water.
Temper rai, pyaaz, vegetables and curry patta in oil.
Mix in the sevai and squeeze over nimbu.

dishes.name: Rajma Masala with Jeera Rice
dishes.desc: Rajma with fragrant jeera chawal.
steps: Soak rajma overnight and boil in a pressure cooker.
Make a pyaaz-tamatar masala, add the rajma and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with jeera chawal.

dishes.name: Sabut Moong Dal with Phulka
dishes.desc: A light dal full of fibre.
steps: Pressure cook the sabut moong until soft.
Add a tadka of adrak, pyaaz and tamatar.
Serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Besan Methi Puda
dishes.desc: A puda with the aroma of methi.
steps: Make a batter of besan, chopped methi, pyaaz, spices and water.
Cook thin pudas on a tawa.
Serve hot with chutney.

dishes.name: Dal Tadka with Gobhi Matar Sabzi and Roti
dishes.desc: Simple home cooking.
steps: Pressure cook the dal and add a tadka.
Cook gobhi and matar covered with jeera and haldi.
Serve with roti.

dishes.name: Egg Pulao with Raita
dishes.desc: A protein-rich pulao in one pot.
steps: Boil the eggs and peel them.
Saute jeera, pyaaz, matar and chawal in oil and cook in double the water.
Mix in the egg pieces and serve with raita.

dishes.name: Poha with Matar and Gajar
dishes.desc: A colourful, light poha.
steps: Rinse the poha and drain well.
Temper rai, pyaaz, gajar and matar in oil.
Mix in the poha, cover for 2 minutes and squeeze over nimbu.

dishes.name: Dahi Bhindi with Moong Dal and Phulka
dishes.desc: Bhindi in a tangy dahi gravy.
steps: Cook the bhindi in a little oil.
Add whisked dahi and spices and cover for 3 minutes.
Serve with moong dal and phulka.

dishes.name: Paneer Tikka (Pan-Grilled) with Phulka and Salad
dishes.desc: Spiced paneer grilled on a tawa.
steps: Marinate paneer and shimla mirch in dahi and tikka masala.
Cook on a tawa in a little oil until golden on all sides.
Serve with phulka and salad.

dishes.name: Moong Dal Paratha with Dahi
dishes.desc: A stuffed paratha rich in protein.
steps: Soak dhuli moong dal and cook it dry with spices.
Stuff into atta dough and roll out.
Cook on a tawa and serve with dahi.

dishes.name: Kadhi Pakoda (Light) with Chawal
dishes.desc: Pakoras made in an appe pan with little oil.
steps: Make besan and pyaaz pakoras in an appe pan.
Cook the dahi-besan kadhi for 15 minutes.
Add the pakoras, finish with a tadka and serve with chawal.

dishes.name: Tawa Sabzi with Roti
dishes.desc: A spicy mixed vegetable sabzi on a tawa.
steps: Cook tamatar and spices in oil on a tawa.
Add chopped vegetables and cook covered.
Mash lightly on the tawa and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Sattu Paratha with Chaas
dishes.desc: Warming and rich in protein.
steps: Mix sattu with pyaaz, nimbu, ajwain and salt for the filling.
Stuff into atta dough and roll out.
Cook on a tawa and serve with chaas.

dishes.name: Chana Masala (Light) with Phulka
dishes.desc: A chana masala with little oil.
steps: Soak chane overnight and boil in a pressure cooker.
Make a pyaaz-tamatar masala and add the chane.
Simmer for 10 minutes and serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Masoor Dal Khichdi with Aloo Bharta
dishes.desc: A light khichdi with aloo bharta.
steps: Pressure cook chawal and masoor dal with a ghee-jeera tadka.
Boil aloo, mash it and mix with green chilli, salt and a little oil.
Serve hot khichdi with the bharta.

dishes.name: Paneer Stuffed Besan Cheela
dishes.desc: A stuffed cheela with a double dose of protein.
steps: Make a thin besan batter.
Mix crumbled paneer with pyaaz, green chilli and spices.
Cook the cheela and fold over the filling.

dishes.name: Mixed Dal with Lauki Sabzi and Roti
dishes.desc: A light, balanced thali.
steps: Pressure cook the mixed dal and add a tadka.
Cook lauki with jeera and tamatar.
Serve with roti.

dishes.name: Veg Jalfrezi with Phulka
dishes.desc: Colourful vegetables in a spicy sauce.
steps: Cook a tamatar puree with spices.
Add chopped vegetables and cook on high heat for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with phulka.

dishes.name: Masala Omelette with Multigrain Toast
dishes.desc: A fluffy omelette with fibre-rich toast.
steps: Whisk eggs with chopped pyaaz, green chilli, dhaniya and salt.
Cook the omelette on a tawa in a little oil.
Serve hot with multigrain toast.

dishes.name: Hara Chana Masala with Roti
dishes.desc: A sabzi of fresh green chana.
steps: Lightly boil the hara chana.
Make an adrak, pyaaz and tamatar masala.
Add the chana, cook for 8 minutes and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Dal Palak with Phulka
dishes.desc: A light, green dal.
steps: Pressure cook the dal with palak.
Add a lahsun-jeera tadka.
Serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Aloo Pyaaz Paratha with Dahi
dishes.desc: A paratha stuffed with aloo and pyaaz.
steps: Mash aloo and mix with finely chopped pyaaz and spices.
Stuff into atta dough and roll out.
Cook on a tawa with a little ghee and serve with dahi.

dishes.name: Chole Kulche (Baked)
dishes.desc: A Sunday special with oven-baked kulche.
steps: Soak chane overnight, pressure cook and simmer with masala.
Knead maida and dahi into a dough and roll out the kulche.
Bake in an oven or cook on a tawa and serve with the chole.

dishes.name: Palak Makai Sabzi with Roti
dishes.desc: A light sabzi of palak and sweet corn.
steps: Boil the palak and blend to a puree.
Saute pyaaz and lahsun, then add the puree and sweet corn.
Cook for 8 minutes and serve with roti.

dishes.name: Lobia Masala with Chawal
dishes.desc: A light, spiced dal-like curry.
steps: Soak lobia for 4 hours and boil in a pressure cooker.
Make an adrak, pyaaz and tamatar masala.
Add the lobia and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with chawal.

dishes.name: Sarson Saag with Makki Roti
dishes.desc: The best of winter food.
steps: Boil sarson and palak with adrak and green chilli, then blend coarsely.
Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes and finish with a little makhan.
Make rotis from makki atta and serve with the saag.

dishes.name: Tamatar Dhaniya Dal with Phulka
dishes.desc: A light dinner after a heavy lunch.
steps: Cook the dal with tamatar and stir in dhaniya.
Add a jeera tadka.
Serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Masoor Dal with Beans Sabzi and Phulka
dishes.desc: A light, homely thali.
steps: Pressure cook masoor dal with haldi and salt for 3 whistles.
Cook beans covered with jeera and tamatar.
Temper the dal and serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Dahi Poha with Kheera
dishes.desc: A cool, light breakfast for summer.
steps: Rinse the poha and soak for 5 minutes.
Mix whisked dahi, poha, chopped kheera and salt.
Top with anaar seeds and black pepper and serve cold.

dishes.name: Tori Moong Dal with Phulka
dishes.desc: A light, cooling summer meal.
steps: Pressure cook moong dal with haldi and salt.
Cook tori covered with jeera and tamatar.
Temper the dal and serve with phulka.

dishes.name: Pudina Pulao with Raita
dishes.desc: A pulao with the coolness of pudina.
steps: Wash chawal and soak for 20 minutes.
Saute jeera, matar and ground pudina, then add the chawal.
Add double the water and cook. Serve with chilled raita.

dishes.name: Tinda Sabzi with Roti
dishes.desc: A light summer sabzi.
steps: Peel and chop the tinda.
Cook covered with pyaaz, tamatar and spices.
Serve hot with roti.

dishes.name: Masala Bhutta Chaat
dishes.desc: A monsoon treat with hot corn.
steps: Boil the sweet corn.
Mix with chopped pyaaz, tamatar and spices.
Squeeze over nimbu and serve warm.

dishes.name: Baked Moong Dal Pakode with Chutney
dishes.desc: Low-oil pakodas for rainy days.
steps: Soak moong dal, grind coarsely and mix in the spices.
Bake in an appe pan or oven until golden.
Serve hot with green chutney.

dishes.name: Dal Palak Soup with Toast
dishes.desc: A light meal for a rainy evening.
steps: Pressure cook the dal and palak and blend lightly.
Add a lahsun tadka and black pepper.
Serve hot soup with toast.
